subject: Animation
title: Pixar's Unbroken Streak
description: A micro-lesson that makes Pixar's Unbroken Streak usable.

hook.text: From 1995 to 2010, Pixar released eleven consecutive films that were all critical and commercial hits.

buildup.text: No other studio in history has matched that streak. Every single film was acclaimed and profitable.

discovery.text: The streak happened because Pixar prioritized story quality over release schedules and merchandise.

twist.text: Cars 2 in 2011 broke the streak. Critics called it Pixar's first misfire, driven by toy sales.

climax.text: The broken streak proved even Pixar was vulnerable when commercial pressure overrode creative instinct.

punchline.text: Eleven perfect films in a row. Then merchandise won.

quiz.question: What ended Pixar's unbroken streak of critically acclaimed films?
options: The studio ran out of original ideas
Cars 2, widely seen as driven by merchandise potential rather than story quality
